description: A design/frontend skill bundle — the single entry point for high-fidelity UI work. Loading ui-pack pulls in the whole UI toolchain at once: clone-website (extraction + builder dispatch), ui-ux-pro-max (design intelligence), and impeccable + emil-design-eng (polish & taste) — and points you at the agent-browser CLI for real-browser building and verification. Use it before any UI cloning, building, reviewing, or polishing so every helper skill is loaded consistently in one step instead of remembering each one. (Motion craft lives in the separate ui-animation skill — load that too when you need animation.)
